# EduLog v2.0.0-alpha.11

EduLog discovers configured GoTrue sign-in methods and provides a system-owner wizard for custom OAuth and OIDC providers. New providers are saved disabled and become available after the administrator confirms the callback and enables them. Existing accounts can link enabled providers through Account security.

This version adds email codes and magic links, SMS sign-in, SAML, passkeys, authenticator apps, phone and security-key MFA, and recovery codes when the corresponding GoTrue features are enabled. HTTP and WebSocket entry points require enrolled users to complete MFA. Changing account email or password preserves the verified browser session.

An optional OIDC server lets administrators register external applications. Users can review consent and revoke grants. Third-party tokens are restricted at EduLog API, PostgREST, Storage and Realtime data boundaries. SCIM provisioning awaits a supported GoTrue release.

Browser sessions expire after 8 hours of inactivity or 30 days. Extension pairing requires the six-digit code displayed by the extension. This release also tightens API rate limiting, browser resource policies and permission-table writes, narrows the default pooler bind address to loopback, updates the Presidio image, and adds automated security scans. The repository includes the November UI/UX and accessibility review.

Apply migrations through `1000183_security_hardening_p2.sql` before deploying the matching API, frontend and extension. Pending pairing requests created before migration 1000183 are revoked and can be restarted. Keep GoTrue pinned to `v2.197.0`. The private `edulog_auth` schema contains the PostgREST request guard. Back up the database and retain existing Auth encryption and JWT keys.

Provider administration requires explicit deployment enablement, exact allowed HTTPS origins, a system permission and recent authentication. Configure the same egress restrictions for EduLog and GoTrue. See the [authentication deployment guide](../../docs/deployment/auth-oauth-mail.md). The legacy Kong overlay keeps the outbound OAuth server disabled.

The release owner approved publication with staging acceptance waived. Real Authentik account linking, SAML, mail/SMS delivery, passkey/security-key flows, shared egress restrictions and end-to-end Storage/Realtime external-token isolation have not been verified for this candidate. Keep optional features disabled until the corresponding deployment checks pass. Automated tests cover provider lifecycle, password and TOTP, OIDC consent/replay/revocation, PostgREST rejection, SQL isolation, and browser UI behavior.
